scope: Read-only current pinned SDK/source and closed parent HIL evidence. No build, hardware commands, production/config edits, fault injection or SDK patch.
head: 8a1794ce3be95ff0007698c4e4e667dcf25fbe19

components/esp_psram/Kconfig.spiram.comm.finding: Explicit WiFi/lwIP SPIRAM-first flag supports current CAPS_ALLOC, internal fallback; general malloc/reserve policy is distinct.

components/esp_wifi/Kconfig.finding: Enabling SPIRAM_TRY_ALLOCATE_WIFI_LWIP while IGNORE_NOTFOUND is false disables dynamic TX choice; static TX defaults16 and cache TX32. This is not a same-buffer-count placement-only change.

components/esp_wifi/esp32s3/esp_adapter..finding: wifi allocation wrappers can prefer SPIRAM; queue/FreeRTOS metadata and explicit internal DMA allocations remain internal.

components/lwip/port/include/lwipopts.h.finding: mem_clib_malloc/calloc prefer SPIRAM only under the explicit flag.

components/freertos/heap_idf.c.finding: Ordinary dynamic FreeRTOS allocations require INTERNAL|8BIT; external-stack allowance alone does not relocate them.

components/esp_system/include/esp_task.h.finding: Non-nano format adds512 bytes: current TCPIP3584 and default event2816 bytes before TCB/queue/other resources.

components/lwip/port/freertos/sys_arch.c.finding: Mailbox mem_malloc + internal xQueueCreate can return ERR_MEM; failed task creation returns NULL.

components/lwip/lwip/src/api/tcpip.c.finding: tcpip_init asserts if mailbox creation fails; ignores sys_thread_new return.

components/esp_netif/lwip/esp_netif_lwip.finding: esp_netif_init waits on initialized semaphore. Default netif start uses ESP_ERROR_CHECK for config sanity and lwip_add; these are panic-capable SDK boundaries, not ordinary owner-return errors.

components/esp_wifi/src/wifi_init.c.finding: PSRAM-backed TX cache policy also has runtime compatibility checks; cache count0 is not supported in the enabled case.

components/heap/include/esp_heap_caps.h.finding: SDK failed-allocation callback(size,caps,function_name) is available independent of heap hook tracing; no hook was added.

components/heap/heap_caps.c.finding: Failure callback runs on final failed allocation; preference helper can report the final attempted caps, not all preference attempts.

docs/en/api-guides/wifi.rst.finding: Static RX and TX hardware buffers are DMA memory (~1600B each); generic SPIRAM availability does not replace internal DMA capacity.

observed.physical_root_cause: UNKNOWN. BOOT reset=panic proves reset classification, not assertion location, OOM, stack overflow, or owner-timeout causality.

memory_model.current_runtime_profile: TransportBuildWifiConfig selects HIGH; existing backend applies staticRX8/dynamicRX16/dynamicTX16/rxBA6/mgmt12. No implicit BLE_COMPAT fallback.
memory_model.new_owner_payload: 7424 bytes explicitly PSRAM, persistent; task4096 bytes internal. Control RX task4096 internal created last.
memory_model.other_known_stacks: TCPIP3584 and default event2816 internal plus TCB, queues and vendor WiFi task/resources. Full aggregate/peak cannot be derived from these partial sums.
memory_model.psram_flag_coupling: With IGNORE_NOTFOUND false, enabling TRY_ALLOCATE_WIFI_LWIP forces static TX. Default16*~1600 bytes adds ~25.6KB DMA allocation plus cache policy. Existing app only overrides dynamic_tx_buf_num and would not tune newly selected static count. Do not blindly enable one flag.
memory_model.not_guaranteed: 8MB total free PSRAM does not prove internal RAM, contiguous task-stack or DMA eligibility. Largest-block and allocation capabilities matter.

hypotheses_not_observed_root_cause: tcpip_init mailbox allocation failure is an explicit LWIP_ASSERT boundary before the owner can receive an error.
tcpip task allocation failure instead returns NULL ignored by tcpip_init and can leave esp_netif_init blocked; the persistent owner watchdog is designed to isolate this case, not prevent SDK panic.
Default AP netif-start SDK path contains ESP_ERROR_CHECK on configuration and netif_add. This is a potential panic-capable boundary; no evidence this branch was reached in the recorded run.
Task-stack canary/watchpoint panic remains unexcluded. No panic text/backtrace or in-job stack water mark was captured.
recommended_next_step: Parent has approved bounded RTC panic diagnostics; wait for exact phase/PC/assert evidence, then select a targeted correction. Do not tune memory counts, disable assertions, relax thresholds or claim an OOM root cause from current evidence.
gate: INVESTIGATION_ONLY; actual AP panic remains blocking and source hypotheses are not a fix or root-cause proof.
